notes: The analysis of type of the female inmates shows that, as in the case of
total prison inmates, the percentage share of undertrial women prisoners was also
very high when compared to other type of prison inmates. Barring UT of A&N
islands, Daman & Diu and Lakshadweep, the percentage share varied around 56%
to 100% in the above states. The female prisoners in Nagaland (11), Sikkim (4)
and Dadra & Nagar Haveli (2) kept in the Jail were all Undertrials (100%). The
other States which recorded high percentage of Undertrials women prisons to the
total women inmates were Uttar Pradesh (92.5%), Orissa (86.9%), Himachal
Pradesh (85.7%), Karnataka (85.2%), Andhra Pradesh (82.8%) and UT of Delhi
